item.title: Karina Successfully Passed Her Master's Defense
item.description: Congratulations to Karina on successfully passing her master’s defense!

item.title: Lab Dinner at a Korean Fine-Dining Restaurant
item.description: Our lab gathered for a Korean fine-dining dinner to celebrate the end of the spring semester and reflect on our ongoing research on generative AI-mediated anticipatory dining experiences.

item.title: CXD Lab Attends CHI 2026 in Barcelona
item.description: Phuong Vu Thao, Wooje Kang, Hyunju Kim, and Prof. Bokyung Lee attended CHI 2026 in Barcelona to present research, learn from the HCI community, hold research meetings, and explore the city together.

item.title: TwistLens Receives Honorable Mention Award at CHI 2026
item.description: TwistLens was presented at CHI 2026 and received an Honorable Mention Award for its contribution to museum experience design and human-computer interaction.

item.title: DanXeReflect Receives Honorable Mention Award at CHI 2026
